role: President & Founder, V International Inc. · New York City · Est. 1989
slogan: Bharat Bhai Chhe toh USA ma BOLLYWOOD CHHE!!!
philosophy: Always be transparent, and there is no shortcut to success. Learn to respect criticism.
introduction: For over 35 years, Bharat Goradia has brought the biggest names in Bollywood to audiences across the USA.
biography: For over 35 years, Bharat Goradia has been a cultural bridge between India and the USA. Through V International Inc., which he founded in New York City in 1989, he has brought Bollywood stars and shows to American audiences: hundreds of sold-out concerts, national drama tours and Navratri festivals.

seo.description: Bharat Goradia, Mr. Bollywood in the USA, has brought Bollywood stars, concerts, drama tours and Navratri festivals to American audiences for over 35 years through V International Inc., New York.
